en: Explain why the basis period matters for compliance, tax estimation and tax liability
Determine the basis period of a company that has just commenced operations
Apply the CP204 rules: estimates, 85% minimum, instalments, revisions and the 10% penalty
Determine basis periods when a company changes its accounting date
State the notification rules (CP204B) for a change of accounting period

blocks.en: The basis period is the period whose income is taxed in a given Year of Assessment (YA). Getting it right affects three areas of tax management.
blocks.ms: Tempoh asas ialah tempoh yang pendapatannya dicukai dalam sesuatu Tahun Taksiran (YA). Ketepatannya memberi kesan kepada tiga bidang pengurusan cukai.

en: Identifies reporting duties, deadlines and accuracy for each YA
ms: Mengenal pasti kewajipan pelaporan, tarikh akhir dan ketepatan bagi setiap YA

en: Gives the basis for estimating tax chargeable
ms: Menjadi asas untuk menganggar cukai yang dikenakan

en: Fixes adjusted income, the correct capital allowance claim, chargeable income and tax for the YA
ms: Menentukan pendapatan diselaraskan, tuntutan elaun modal yang betul, pendapatan bercukai dan cukai bagi YA

ms: Hantar selewat-lewatnya 30 hari sebelum permulaan tempoh asas [s107C(2)]

blocks.en: On slide 12 the exemption (two assessment years) and the paid-up capital headings (above/below RM2.5m SMEs) sit in separate columns, so I could not pair them reliably. The commonly stated rule is that SMEs (paid-up capital RM2.5m or less) are exempt for the first two YAs, but confirm this with your lecturer. This is Extra (not clearly in slides).
blocks.ms: Pada slaid 12 pengecualian (dua tahun taksiran) dan tajuk modal berbayar (atas/bawah RM2.5j, PKS) berada dalam lajur berasingan, jadi saya tidak dapat memadankannya dengan pasti. Peraturan lazim ialah PKS (modal berbayar RM2.5j ke bawah) dikecualikan bagi dua YA pertama, tetapi sahkan dengan pensyarah. Ini Extra (tidak jelas dalam slaid).

blocks.en: Minimum estimate
blocks.ms: Anggaran minimum

en: Year 1: a new entity estimates from projected profits
Year 2 onwards: at least 85% of the prior year’s estimate [s107C(3)]
ms: Tahun 1: entiti baru menganggar daripada unjuran keuntungan
Tahun ke-2 dan seterusnya: sekurang-kurangnya 85% daripada anggaran tahun sebelumnya [s107C(3)]

blocks.en: Instalments
blocks.ms: Ansuran

en: Equal monthly instalments, each due on the 15th day of the calendar month [s107C(12)]
Already-operating entities start from the 2nd month of the basis period; newly established ones start from the 6th month
ms: Ansuran bulanan sama, setiap satu perlu dibayar pada hari ke-15 bulan kalendar [s107C(12)]
Entiti yang sudah beroperasi bermula dari bulan ke-2 tempoh asas; yang baru ditubuhkan bermula dari bulan ke-6

blocks.en: Slide 15 lists ‘2nd month’ and ‘6th month’ and the two entity types in separate boxes; I paired them as above (existing = 2nd month, new = 6th month), which matches the usual rule. This pairing is my reading.
blocks.ms: Slaid 15 menyenaraikan ‘bulan ke-2’ dan ‘bulan ke-6’ serta dua jenis entiti dalam kotak berasingan; saya padankan seperti di atas (sedia ada = bulan ke-2, baru = bulan ke-6), selaras dengan peraturan lazim. Pemadanan ini bacaan saya.

blocks.en: Revising the estimate (e-CP204A) [s107C(7)]
blocks.ms: Menyemak semula anggaran (e-CP204A) [s107C(7)]

blocks.en: Penalty for an under-estimate
blocks.ms: Penalti kerana anggaran kurang

blocks.en: If actual tax payable (AT) exceeds the estimate (ET) by more than 30% of AT, a 10% increase applies to the excess.
blocks.ms: Jika cukai sebenar (AT) melebihi anggaran (ET) lebih 30% daripada AT, kenaan 10% dikenakan ke atas lebihan itu.

blocks.en: Lecturer’s exercise 4: ET (revised) RM600,000, AT RM890,000. Difference 290,000; 30% × 890,000 = 267,000; excess 23,000; penalty = 10% × 23,000 = RM2,300, so the amount due is RM890,000 + RM2,300.
blocks.ms: Latihan 4 pensyarah: ET (disemak) RM600,000, AT RM890,000. Beza 290,000; 30% × 890,000 = 267,000; lebihan 23,000; penalti = 10% × 23,000 = RM2,300, jadi amaun perlu dibayar RM890,000 + RM2,300.

blocks.en: The first year a company fails to close its accounts on the normal date is the ‘failure year’. The Director General (DG) sets the basis periods for the failure year and the year after, under two rules: (a) no YA is missing; (b) no two accounts close in the same YA.
blocks.ms: Tahun pertama syarikat gagal menutup akaun pada tarikh biasa ialah ‘tahun kegagalan’. Ketua Pengarah (DG) menetapkan tempoh asas bagi tahun kegagalan dan tahun selepasnya, di bawah dua peraturan: (a) tiada YA tertinggal; (b) tiada dua akaun ditutup dalam YA yang sama.

en: Under 12 months, ends in the same year
Combine accounts for the entire period
ms: Kurang 12 bulan, berakhir dalam tahun sama

en: Under 12 months, ends in the following year
Accept the accounting period of the failure year
More than 12 months, ends in the following year
Accept the accounting period of the failure year
More than 12 months, ends in the third year
Divide the accounting period into two periods
Koperasi Rania Emas (normal 31 Dec → 31 Jan, 13 months): YA2024 = 1.1.24–31.7.24 (7 months); YA2025 = 1.8.24–31.1.25 (6 months); YA2026 = 1.2.25–31.1.26
ms: Bahagikan tempoh perakaunan kepada dua tempoh

blocks.en: The slides do not state how the DG chooses where to split the period; the 7/6-month split is simply the slide’s example. Slide 19’s two tables are also laid out confusingly; I report the basis-period table. The ‘ends in the third year’ label is the slide’s wording.

Applying the ‘under 12 months, following year’ rule: YA2022 none; YA2023 = 1.4.22–30.6.23; YA2024 = 1.7.23–31.3.24; YA2025 = 1.4.24–31.3.25; YA2026 = 1.4.25–31.3.26. blocks.ms: Latihan 1 pensyarah (Teraju Dagang): mula 1.4.2022, akaun pertama hingga 30.6.2023, kemudian 1.7.2023–31.3.2024 (9 bulan, pertukaran ke 31 Mac; latihan tersalah cetak tahun). en: The company must notify the IRBM of the change using Form CP204B

Di bawah s107C(8) KPHDN boleh mengeluarkan Notis Bayaran Ansuran (CP205) jika Borang CP204 tidak dikemukakan tepat pada masanya, atau pertukaran tempoh perakaunan dimaklumkan melalui CP204B

30 days before the end of the new accounting period

blocks.en: New operation or partnership
blocks.ms: Operasi baharu atau perkongsian

en: A company with existing operations that starts a new operation: the new operation’s basis period equals that of the existing operation
A company that joins a partnership: the basis period for the partnership business equals that of the existing operation

Syarikat yang menyertai perkongsian: tempoh asas perniagaan perkongsian sama dengan operasi sedia ada
